title: District Wine Village Deluxe Tour - PUBLIC
includes: Pickup/Drop-off from your vacation property or residence
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Travel time added to the total time duration
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Attention wine lovers! Sagebrush Tours is thrilled to announce the launch of our newest and most exclusive tour yet — the District Wine Village Deluxe Tour.

Embark on a wine adventure like no other. Limited spots are available, so don’t miss out on this unique experience. 

Explore the Heart of Wine Country
Nestled in the picturesque town of Oliver, BC, the District Wine Village is waiting to be discovered. This exceptional destination offers a perfect blend of world-class wine, food, and entertainment, making it an ideal spot for our new tour.
